calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sale,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale,
  COUNT(DISTINCT channel_code) as channels
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
  channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY channel_code
ORDER BY channel_code

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN sale_date < '2025-11-03' THEN 'Before migration'
    ELSE 'After migration'
  END as period,
  channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN sale_date < '2025-11-03' THEN 'Before migration'
    ELSE 'After migration'
  END,
  channel_code
ORDER BY period, line_count DESC
